method: One search per barrier type; top 20 of each read by hand. Two label fields, deliberately: 'found_by' is mechanical provenance (which searches returned the case), 'barrier' is judgment (what the case holds), cross-checked against term frequency in the full text. They usually agree. Where they don't, found_by is the unreliable one — a case can match a citation it only mentions in passing.

queries.procedural: "1421(c)" AND ("de novo" OR "denial of naturalization") AND dateFiled:[2010-01-01 TO 2026-08-07]
queries.character: "good moral character" AND ("1101(f)" OR "1427(a)") AND dateFiled:[2010-01-01 TO 2026-08-07]
queries.linguistic: ("1423" OR "N-648" OR "Medical Certification for Disability Exception" OR "English and civics") AND naturaliz* AND dateFiled:[2000-01-01 TO 2026-08-07]
queries.financial: ("I-912" OR "fee waiver") AND naturaliz* AND dateFiled:[2000-01-01 TO 2026-08-07]

selected.case_name: Elvis Leonel Morfa Diaz v. Acting Secretary, Department of Homeland Security

selected.case_name: Moya v. United States Department of Homeland Security
selected.why: Denied disability exemptions from the English and civics tests. Review barred until administrative exhaustion, and the Rehabilitation Act gives no cause of action against executive agencies acting as regulators — closing the disability-discrimination route
Exhaustion is not jurisdictional but is enforceable; lost for missing his N-336 hearing

selected.case_name: Gonzalez v. Secretary of Department of HomeLand Security
selected.why: Denied on GMC grounds for false testimony at his I-751 interview; separately holds that courts can hear a denial case with removal pending, since declaratory relief is available

selected.case_name: Muhanad Al-Hasani v. Secretary United States Department of Homeland Sec
selected.why: Polygamy as a statutory bar to good moral character; court notes he becomes eligible in 2027, five years after his 2022 divorce
Conduct predating the application by over a year counts toward GMC; oral affirmation of false written statements is false testimony
selected.note: 108 cites are largely summary-judgment boilerplate; kept for the GMC holding
